title: Properties of Materials for Manufacturing
description: The course will survey material properties, processes, and applications used in the manufacturing industry. The course emphasizes job related skills required by manufacturing industries. Topics will include a brief introduction to the properties of metals, polymers, ceramics, bonding material, and composites. Students will be introduced to common manufacturing standards and processes for testing and applying materials. Students will practice various bonding and assembly techniques using recommended procedures, as well as standard materials characterization techniques. Some labs will be held at different industry sites based on the skill being learned. Field trips will be required.
outcomes: Identify six different property classifications of materials that determine their applicability.
Identify four components that are involved in the design, production, and utilization of materials, and briefly describe the interrelationships between these components.
Identify three criteria that are important in the materials selection process.
Identify the three primary classifications of solid materials, and then cite the distinctive chemical feature of each.
Identify methods used to test and characterize various materials.

Perform three different material application processes (including material selection, application fabrication techniques, relevant testing that could be performed, and necessary characterization technique based on the application).
content: Applications and Processing of Metal Alloys
Characteristics, Applications, and Processing of Polymers
Economic and Social Issues Related to Materials
lab: Demonstrate Safety Practices, Equipment Usage, and Proper Data Gathering and Storage Within the Laboratory
